description: Status of a quote request previously submitted via request_quote. Needs the ticket id (PCB-XXXXXX) AND the e-mail address used on the request; returns the current status, any note from the project manager and the status history. Does not return the request contents. Experimental: the status may lag behind the e-mail conversation — the e-mail thread with expo@peoplecanbuild.com is authoritative.

email.description: E-mail address used on the request

ticket_id.description: Ticket id returned by request_quote, e.g. PCB-7K3QW2

name: get_quote_status
